name: TURIYA
recent: TURIYA 完成私募配售，发行 2287 万股新股，并迎来 Dato' Wira Vijayasundram Jeyabalan 成为第二大股东。公司委任 Nor Shahmir 为董事经理，此外，并将在股东大会上寻求批准。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行 22,872,800 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.40。
Dato' Wira Vijayasundram Jeyabalan 通过配售认购成为第二大股东，持股 9.09%。
委任 Nor Shahmir bin Nor Shahid 为董事经理。
risks: 私募配售新股可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
需获得股东特别决议通过。

news.title: Insider Moves: United Malacca Bhd, Turiya Bhd, Foodie Media Bhd, AMMB Holdings Bhd, Malakoff Corp Bhd
Vijayasundaram Jeyabalan emerges as Turiya’s second-largest shareholder with 9.09% stake via placement
Nor Shahmir Nor Shahid is Turiya MD
VJ Balan emerges as Turiya’s second-largest shareholder
Turiya appoints Nor Shahmir as managing director

recent_en: TURIYA completed a private placement of 22.87 million new shares, with Dato' Wira Vijayasundram Jeyabalan emerging as the second-largest shareholder. The company appointed Nor Shahmir as Managing Director and proposed a name change to Eurasia Integrated Berhad. It also proposed the acquisition of Wisma Sentral Inai office building, to be tabled at a general meeting.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 22,872,800 new shares at RM0.40 per share.
Dato' Wira Vijayasundram Jeyabalan emerged as the second-largest shareholder with a 9.09% stake via the placement.
Appointed Nor Shahmir bin Nor Shahid as Managing Director.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
The proposed change of company name requires shareholders' approval via special resolution.
